name: Loving West Virginia
old_description: Unleash mythical creatures with Cryptid Playing Cards. Each deck features iconic cryptids like Mothman, Bigfoot, Flatwoods Monster, and Batboy perfect for any card game. Embrace the unknown and add some mystery to your next game night.
about:
Loving West Virginia operates from Fairmont, West Virginia, selling state-themed merchandise through its e-commerce site lovingwv.com. The founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in the available sources.

The company offers a range of West Virginia–branded consumer products including Cryptid Playing Cards featuring Mothman, Bigfoot, Flatwoods Monster, and Batboy; apparel collections for adults and youth; vinyl decals; 8×10 art prints on 100 lb cardstock; glassware; can coolers; a 55-county scratch-off map; and a monthly mystery-sticker subscription club. Flood-relief fundraiser shirts and stickers are also part of the lineup.

Customers are primarily individual consumers seeking West Virginia souvenirs, gifts, and novelty items. The product assortment targets fans of state folklore, outdoor recreation, and regional pride, with youth sizes and fundraiser items indicating a family-oriented audience.

No explicit statement about the company's founding mission or competitive differentiation beyond the product themes is provided in the source material.
